consensus_summary: Fans overwhelmingly agree that the 1987-06-26 show at Alpine Valley was a high-energy performance with standout moments, particularly in the second set. The China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider sequence and the unique ending of Eyes of the World received particular praise, contributing to an unforgettable experience for many attendees.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.3 for 36 reviews + 1.2 sentiment: The overall enthusiasm and memorable performances highlighted by multiple reviewers suggest a strong positive sentiment, despite some minor criticisms.
